messages:
maria (marketing): Hey @alex — quick favor for the webinar next Tue. We want a tiny reproducibility rerun to validate a few claims for the demo slides. Not a full sweep, just a lightweight pack we can point to in the deck.

maria (marketing): Requirements: ~500 random samples (representative mix), quantized 4-bit variant, coldstart warmup profile, and one fixed warmup seed so results are repeatable. Need p50/p95/p99 latency and per-token cost snapshot + a short note if we see any tail regressions.

alex (runtime): OK. Quick clarifying q's: 1) Is the 500 samples with same token-length distribution as our launch cohort? 2) Which model checkpoint exactly (we have redwood-v2, redwood-v2-optim, redwood-quant-4)? 3) Do you want traces/timeseries attached or just aggregate percentiles?

maria (marketing): 1) Yes, please mirror the launch cohort token-length buckets (short/medium/long). 2) Use `redwood-quant-4` (the quantized variant we mentioned in the whitepaper). 3) Aggregate percentiles + a small CSV with per-sample latency so we can plot a simple violin if needed.

alex (runtime): Got it. I'll spin a quick targeted job. Plan: mini-cohort run on a single dedicated GPU node, coldstart profile, warmup seed=42. I can attach the per-sample CSV and a small summary doc. ETA ~20–30m.

alex (runtime): Command I'll run (for visibility):
```
redwood run-bench --cohort mini --samples 500 --token-buckets short,medium,long --model redwood-quant-4 --warmup-profile coldstart --warmup-seed 42 --output artifacts/1717456000-mini-snap
```

sam (devex): +1 to attaching trace ids. If marketing wants a small trace sample (3–5 requests) with kv-cache heatmaps, we can include that. Also recommend grabbing the first 50 coldstarts for variance calc.

maria (marketing): Please include the 3 trace samples. Also add a note if any reroute/fallbacks occurred during the run. We want to be transparent on fallback behavior.

runtime-bot: Job queued: job_id=jb_1717456000_1, cluster=d-prd-small, priority=high.

runtime-bot: Job started: job_id=jb_1717456000_1. Estimated runtime ~18m. Artifacts will be uploaded to `s3://redwood-marketing-artifacts/1717456000-mini-snap/` on completion.

alex (runtime): Starting now. Will ping here when finished with a one-paragraph summary and links to the CSV + traces.

maria (marketing): Amazing — thanks. If you spot any weird p99 spikes, highlight them and call out sample ids so we can exclude/annotate in the deck. :pray:

sam (devex): If you want, I can post-process the CSV to produce the violin and the small two-line methods note for the slide (sample provenance + warmup profile). Ping me after artifacts are up.

alex (runtime): Will do. Back in ~20m with artifacts.

maria (marketing): Appreciate it — we may loop you in for a 10-min dry run of the slide on Mon AM.

runtime-bot: Job complete: job_id=jb_1717456000_1. runtime=19m12s, p50=45ms, p95=120ms, p99=210ms, avg-per-token-cost=$0.00034. Artifacts: s3://redwood-marketing-artifacts/1717456000-mini-snap/ (summary.txt, per_sample.csv, traces/).

alex (runtime): Summary: mini-cohort run finished. No automatic fallbacks observed. p99 tail driven mostly by long-token bucket; included sample ids 331, 409, 487 in traces. Uploaded summary + CSV + 3 trace captures.

maria (marketing): Perfect. Will draft a short slide blurb and ask Sam to make the violin. Thanks team :tada:
